summary: Discover received public libraries and run caller-supplied inputs for x402 integration repair, tool input compatibility, and task distribution. scripts/task-distribution/cli.mjs classifies a supplied seller integration as free_sufficient or missing_field_not_paid_demand and sends no payment. scripts/dispatch.mjs qualifies compatibility-query for a tool input compatibility decision on the candidate envelope. A description match does not complete the task.
